Fix units automatically

The system reads each material's name and suggests the standard unit - cement in bags, rebar in tonnes, cable in metres. You review and apply.

Add stock to the store or a site

Put material in by hand, any time - the shelves on day one, or a few things that came in without paperwork. Pick a material, say where it is and how many; add as many lines as you need, each to its own place, and record them together. A line marked Rental goes in under the supplier named on that material, so it shows on the rental page. Each goes into the ledger as a receipt, traceable like a delivery.

My notifications

What the bell and your devices tell you about. Untick anything you do not want; it applies to this login everywhere.

Notifications on this device

New requests, approvals, late orders, low stock, missing attendance and expiring documents - whatever this login can open - arrive on this device like a message - on a phone even when the app is closed; on a laptop while Chrome or Edge is open. Turn it on separately on each device you use.

Ask the app from Claude

Connect this app to Claude and ask it anything about the app's data - "LPOs sent in the last 50 days", "every increment, both companies, as Excel". It can only read, never change anything; every question is kept in the Activity monitor. Admin logins only.

  1. Copy the link above.
  2. In Claude: Settings › Connectors › Add custom connector. Name it Infinia, paste the link, Add.
  3. In any chat, turn on Infinia from the tools menu and ask your question.

Show the INFI button again (if you hid it on this device)

Keep the link private - anyone with it can read the app's data. If it is ever shared by mistake, press Make a new link: the old one stops at once.

Backup

The whole system as one file: workers, sites, engineers, attendance, payroll summaries, adjustments, suppliers, the material list, stock movements and material requests. An automatic backup is taken once a day, keeping a rolling 40 days. Backups you take yourself are kept permanently. Anyone can take or download one; only an admin can restore or delete.
